methodology: Walk-forward portfolio backtest: 13 rebalance dates every 3 months over 3 years, full-universe rank-tilt (every scored ticker weighted proportional to its composite_score rank, no hard Buy/Sell exclusion) at each rebalance, 10.0bps round-trip transaction cost on turnover, against a sector-stratified 275-ticker sample of scripts/ticker_universe.json.
